Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units from activities joined with assays, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by assay CHEMBL1614281, standard_value is not null, and standard_relation equals '='. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
